items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was in Detroit one time and we were up at this club where they jammed and Brother Yusef (phonetic sp.) was playing... during an intermission he said, 'Try it.'

ctx.x: One of the things I've always admired about you so much is your ability to play well on all the different instruments. And I think there's a wonderful story behind you getting your first flute that I would love for people to know about.

Oh, I was in Chicago and -- well first of all, before I go there, I was in Detroit one time and we were up at this club where they jammed and Brother Yusef (phonetic sp.) was playing. I forget the name of the club now. And so he was playing flute -­
You're talking about Yusef Latiffe (phonetic sp.)?
